canvas.emptyDescription: Choose a shape above and click to place it. Add labels, then connect your ideas.
canvas.hint: Drag to pan · Ctrl/⌘ + scroll to zoom
canvas.helpBody: Drag or scroll to pan. Ctrl/Command + wheel and touch pinch zoom around the pointer. Arrow keys pan; +/− zoom; 0 resets; Home fits. Choose an insertion tool and click, or press Enter to insert at the view center. Connect chooses source then target. Click a shape to edit, or use Edit and the element list. Escape cancels tools before leaving expanded view. Space + drag and the middle mouse button navigate with any tool. Dragging, resizing and undo are reserved for future element editing.
canvas.snapHelp: Snap aligns new shapes to the configured world grid. Panning stays continuous.
canvas.preview: Basic shapes and text are editable. Specialized content stays preserved; its preview may be simplified.
canvas.limited: Dense view: preview limited to 1,500 visible nodes and 1,500 connections. Zoom in to see more detail. All elements remain in the project.
canvas.adjusted: This saved view exceeds navigation limits. A bounded view is displayed; the original view stays unchanged until you navigate.
canvas.future: This page uses newer view settings. Navigation is temporary; its saved view and settings remain unchanged.
diagram.panHelp: Drag to pan. Click a shape to edit its label and style.
diagram.insertHelp: Click to place. Enter inserts at the view center. Escape cancels; Space + drag pans.
diagram.connectHelp: Choose a source, then a target shape.
diagram.editHelp: Click a shape or connection, or choose an element below to edit.
diagram.sourceHelp: Choose the source shape on the canvas or from the element list.
diagram.targetHelp: Source selected. Choose a different target shape. Escape cancels.
diagram.label: Label / text
diagram.error.endpoint: Choose two different editable shapes on this page.
diagram.error.unsupported: This element contains unsupported content. It is preserved without changes.
diagram.error.invalid: The change could not be applied. Check the values; your diagram is unchanged.
